请选择一个适合贵公司需求的尺寸的空调，因为更大的型号能耗更高。

B. 适当地
C. 出乎意料地
D. 广泛地

items.question: Choose an ------- sized air conditioner for your company’s needs, as larger models use more energy.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“appropriately”代入题干后为“Choose an appropriately sized air conditioner for your company’s needs, as larger models use more energy.”。选择理由：该项的词性或动词形态符合句法位置，同时与上下文语义搭配自然。正确答案：B（appropriately）。
